title: Tax Invoice
key_sentences: This invoice covers the export of two 40-foot high-cube containers of garden furniture from our Westerby depot to the consignee's terminal in Rotterdam.
Vessel MV Calder Spirit, voyage 2641E, sailed from Felixstowe on 4 October 2026.
VAT is charged only on the UK haulage, customs and documentation services; international sea freight and its origin charges are zero-rated.
Please pay by bank transfer within 30 days of the invoice date.
Claims for loss or damage must be notified to us in writing within seven days of delivery.
All business is transacted under our standard trading conditions, a copy of which is available on request.
Interest may be charged on overdue accounts at 4% above the base rate.

rows: Sea freight FCL 40' HC, Felixstowe to Rotterdam

notes: Freight forwarder tax invoice, one page. Letterhead and footer are furniture. Two pairs of side-by-side boxes: at the top the "INVOICE TO" address box (left) then the invoice-details key/value table (right); at the bottom the "PAYMENT DETAILS" box (left, with its bank key/value table) then the "REMARKS" box (right). Reading order is box by box, left box first. "INVOICE TO" is an address label, not a heading; the two lower box titles (typed in capitals, letter-spaced) are level-2 headings. Key/value tables have no header row. Totals rows: the label cell spans four columns and is repeated in each.
